caseFile.summary: The buyer says the demo desk lamp never arrived. Tracking has stalled, delivery is not confirmed, and the shipment address does not match the order. No willingness to settle is recorded, so a refund is recommended.

timeline.event: The buyer ordered one demo desk lamp for $120.00.
The seller shipped the lamp, but the shipment address did not match the order address and no signature was recorded.
Carrier tracking stalled and delivery was not confirmed.
The buyer messaged that the parcel had not arrived and asked the seller to check the delivery.
